phase_1.title: Phase 1 · StG 44 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.92×33mm Kurz primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 340 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 340 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 419 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 685 m/s (1900 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bolt Tilt Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the StG 44 staged for its 500–600 RPM cyclic (controllable intermediate auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖：1944 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 雨果·施迈瑟设计的 StG 44 首次将「中间威力步枪弹、30 发弧形弹匣、连发可控性、直线低后坐轮廓与薄钢板冲压量产」五大现代突击步枪基因集于一身，直接定义了“Assault Rifle（突击步枪）”这一枪种名称。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：StG 44 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1944 年问世的 海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 由德国海内尔武器厂（C.G. Haenel）主导研制，定位为经典的初代突击步枪。1944 年至 1945 年间累计生产逾 42 万支，其战术概念深刻启发了二战后苏联 AK 体系与西方各国中间威力步枪的全面转型。
雨果·施迈瑟设计的 StG 44 首次将「中间威力步枪弹、30 发弧形弹匣、连发可控性、直线低后坐轮廓与薄钢板冲压量产」五大现代突击步枪基因集于一身，直接定义了“Assault Rifle（突击步枪）”这一枪种名称。 整件装备总长 940 mm（木质后托 · 冲压机匣）、空重 4.62 kg，成为同期突击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1944 年，德国海内尔武器厂（C.G. Haenel）推出了划时代的海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖。1944 年至 1945 年间累计生产逾 42 万支，其战术概念深刻启发了二战后苏联 AK 体系与西方各国中间威力步枪的全面转型。 它的核心设计聚焦于7.92×33mm Kurz 中间威力弹精准卡位手枪弹与全威力步枪弹之间的 300 m 交战带，奠定了其在突击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 的机械灵魂在于其「长行程上置导气活塞 · 下倾偏移闭锁枪机（Tilting Bolt）与冲压钢机匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。复进簧内置于枪托长管内，配合下倾闭锁楔块与冲压机匣实现高效战时量产，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 采用长行程上置导气活塞 · 下倾偏移闭锁枪机（Tilting Bolt）与冲压钢机匣。在每个击发周期中，导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了复进簧内置于枪托长管内，配合下倾闭锁楔块与冲压机匣实现高效战时量产。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.92×33mm Kurz 弹药规格与 419 mm 冷锻枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 340 MPa，可赋予弹头 685 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,900 J 动能，有效作用距离达 300 米。
内膛技术特点方面，沿用毛瑟 7.92mm 弹径但将弹壳缩短至 33mm，开创 300 米现代步兵交战弹道范式。同时，首次确立高耸准星座、弧形大容弹匣与独立小握把的现代步枪人体工学范式，令其在 500–600 发/分（可控中间威力弹连发） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 419 毫米身管与 7.92×33mm Kurz 口径，海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 实现了每秒 685 米的初速与 300 米有效射程。沿用毛瑟 7.92mm 弹径但将弹壳缩短至 33mm，开创 300 米现代步兵交战弹道范式，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 43 mm 膛轴设计，海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 将单发后坐冲量控制在 7.4 N·s 水平。铰接分解式下机匣发射机组与自动弹出式防尘抛壳窗盖理念影响深远。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-43）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，铰接分解式下机匣发射机组与自动弹出式防尘抛壳窗盖理念影响深远。欢迎在 BAY-43 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 海内尔 StG 44 突击步枪鼻祖 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the StG 44
paragraphs: Introduced in 1944 by C.G. Haenel Waffen- und Fahrradfabrik in Germany, the Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44) emerged as a defining First-Generation Assault Rifle. Over 425,000 rifles were built in 1944–1945, permanently shifting global infantry small-arms doctrine from full-power bolt actions toward intermediate select-fire rifles.

Hugo Schmeisser’s StG 44 fused intermediate-cartridge ballistics, a 30-round curved magazine, controllable select-fire ergonomics, and stamped sheet-steel construction—coining the very term “assault rifle” (Sturmgewehr). Measuring 940 mm (Wood Buttstock · Stamped Receiver) at an unloaded weight of 4.62 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1944, C.G. Haenel Waffen- und Fahrradfabrik of Germany introduced the Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44). Over 425,000 rifles were built in 1944–1945, permanently shifting global infantry small-arms doctrine from full-power bolt actions toward intermediate select-fire rifles. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 7.92×33mm Kurz bridged pistol submachine guns and full-power rifles across the 300 m combat envelope — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44) sits its Long-Stroke Gas Piston · Rear-Dropping Tilting Bolt in Stamped Sheet-Steel Receiver. Throughout every firing cycle, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction, containing 340 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, In-stock recoil spring, rear-tilting bolt, and stamped-steel receiver streamlined mass production, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44) relies on Long-Stroke Gas Piston · Rear-Dropping Tilting Bolt in Stamped Sheet-Steel Receiver. During each cycle, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: In-stock recoil spring, rear-tilting bolt, and stamped-steel receiver streamlined mass production.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.92×33mm Kurz with 419 mm Steel Barrel (4-Groove RH · 240 mm Twist), the Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44) develops 685 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,900 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 300 meters.

Internally, Shortened 7.92mm Kurz case pioneered the 300 m intermediate-cartridge ballistic envelope. Combined with its 500–600 RPM cyclic (controllable intermediate auto) tempo, Established the enduring high-sight, curved-magazine, pistol-grip assault rifle silhouette, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.92×33mm Kurz through its 419 millimeter bore, the Haenel StG 44 (Sturmgewehr 44) achieves 685 meters per second and 300 meters of effective reach. Shortened 7.92mm Kurz case pioneered the 300 m intermediate-cartridge ballistic envelope.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 43 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 7.4 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Hinged trigger housing and spring-loaded dust cover anticipated postwar modular designs.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-43), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
